title: Conditional κ = 0.001601260169988325: 48 added-kernel and 24 plain joint-prefix calls
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001601260169988325**, with conservative κ = **0.001601260167198213**. The complex supplier binds at **b = 400957079097715286561 / 250000000000000000000000**; the unchanged cited PR543 bit supplier remains nonbinding with its surcharge retained.

PR576 uses its twelve additional cold kernels in eight calls. A joint search over five verified provider families produces a new literal allocation using **48 added-kernel joint-prefix calls and 24 plain joint-prefix calls from PR575**. The new contribution is the provider selection, complete physical owner allocation and admission. No predecessor exponent gains are added, and no new scalar-kernel authorship is claimed.

```
H = {1:171840, 2:37152, 3:27686, 4:13824, 5:4032,
     6:4032, 8:576, 30:1, 48:1817}
```

All 36,288 helper roles, 6,439 actual charts, 27,864 cross-replica roles and 3,008 positive idle remainders are independently reconstructed. Dimension 73, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682, rank mass 520704 and deficit 2560 are unchanged. A pattern/time-flow MILP stopped with a feasible nomination at its time limit; every integer constraint and the matching expansion were checked exactly. Solver and packing optimality are not claimed.

The self-contained standard-library cold verifier rebuilds the entire pinned PR575 chain, then applies PR576's twelve additional kernels to the freshly rebuilt width-seven prefix word. It checks all new omission cases, both 728-column orientations, arbitrary dirt restoration, exact frames, wrappers, all 2,928/3,009 phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters, literal physical ownership, a fresh complete invoice, both rational moment engines, both complex models, seven bootstrap levels and 47 strict outer conditions per model. All 23 owner mutations, 106 assembly mutations, two phase-timing accept/reject pairs, two actual recompressions and 36 proof/reference mutations must pass.

```sh
python3 -B research/joint-prefix-kernel-packing/verify.py --work /absolute/new/joint-prefix-kernel
```

Fresh frozen-source cold replay passed on **macOS/Python 3.14.8 in 395.026 s** and **Linux/Python 3.12.3 in 477.666 s**. Each includes all nine root stages, the complete 39-stage PR575 chain and eight new global stages. Final results are byte-identical; all fourteen proof-content identities and every numerical/semantic invoice field agree. Receipts are in `research/joint-prefix-kernel-packing-validation`. The unchanged baseline reuses PR572’s published 18-group passing evidence, including `gen4-bank-verify`; it is not claimed as a new aggregate execution.

All fourteen provider proof-content identities and complete numerical/semantic contracts are frozen. Regenerated gzip equality uses decompressed content, while actual raw references are independently validated. The constructor recomputes two stale inherited report fields (rank mass and width inventory); every scalar operation, frame, port, entrance and cleanup entry remains identical to PR576. The original source and kernel recipe are preserved, with 271 Git-blob pins and full contributor notices.

The candidate is 0.01062516% above independently replayed PR576 head `f4e9f7e85e9211cf6ba6c5789da2aa0902d9121e` (31 full stages, 258.323 s). Concurrent PR578 `2aacc1f2edae76fc963699be5cfaf31bcf3ef56b` reports κ = 0.001601159251759369 using another owner map for PR576's fixed dispatch; that package has not been independently replayed here. Its reported value is lower, and its owner map is not used.

Credits: `jon314159` supplies PR575's plain joint-prefix provider and complete cold reconstruction, and PR567's portable identities; `jeremykothe2` supplies PR576's twelve kernels and data-driven global audit, and PR568's cold-kernel construction; `DominikScholz` supplies PR571's joint prefix and PR569's width-seven promotions. Our PR577/PR572 supply pattern/time-flow expansion and complete portability controls. Earlier authors, licenses and source-specific AI disclosures are retained in `NOTICE.md` and `vendor/`. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for this derivative's search, implementation, verification and writing.

The all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, normalized recursive interfaces, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. This is conditional finite evidence, not an unconditional theorem, complete Lean proof, practical speedup or κ = 1 result.
